summary: The registrant, CH4 Natural Solutions Corp, filed an 8-K reporting the completion of its IPO of 20 million units at $10.00/unit and a concurrent private placement of 200k units to an affiliate, generating $202M gross. The underwriter partially exercised its over-allotment for 2 million additional units. Net proceeds of $220M were placed in a trust account. This is an ordinary IPO completion event—not a special situation.
